title: Surrender Free Percentage for Seasoned Deferred Fixed Annuities Contracts
content:
On an Ashgrove Deferred Fixed Annuities contract that is late in its surrender charge schedule, a larger share of the contract value on the latest contract anniversary (the initial premium in the first contract year) is free of surrender charge on full surrender. That share is the surrender free percentage.

**Rule.** The surrender free percentage is **15% (0.15)** where the annuitant was aged **70** or more on the latest contract anniversary and the contract is in schedule year **4** or later on the handling date, and **12% (0.12)** where the annuitant was under 70 on that anniversary and the contract is in schedule year 4 or later. Where the contract is in schedule year 3 or earlier on the handling date, neither of these percentages applies, whatever the annuitant's age.

**Condition — result.**

| Annuitant's age on the latest contract anniversary | Schedule year on the handling date | Surrender free percentage under this rule |
|---|---|---|
| 70 or more | 4 or later | 15% |
| Under 70 | 4 or later | 12% |
| Any | 1, 2 or 3 | Neither applies |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).**

1. Annuitant aged 70 on the latest anniversary, contract in schedule year 5: 15%.
2. Annuitant aged 69 on the latest anniversary who has turned 70 since: the age on the anniversary governs, so 12% in schedule year 4 or later.
3. Contract in schedule year 3 on the handling date: neither percentage, at any age; in schedule year 4: one of them applies.
4. With $52000.00 on the latest anniversary, 15% makes $7800.00 of it free and 12% makes $6240.00 free.

Ages are whole years last birthday from the annuitant's date of birth; schedule years run from the surrender charge schedule start date.
